plain_english_policy: This bill does not change laws, budgets, or infrastructure operations. It is purely symbolic: it renames a specific stretch of Alabama Highway 10 (from the Pike County line to Clio) as the 'Don Sutton Highway' in honor of baseball pitcher Don Sutton and requests that official markers be placed along this route.
policy_direction_if_enacted: Enactment would produce no operational policy shift. The only effect is an honorary designation recorded in state records, accompanied by a request to install commemorative signage identifying the road segment as named after Don Sutton.
sponsorship_supports_position: The sponsors (Representatives Boothe and Beasley) affirmatively advanced this honorary naming resolution. No policy positions beyond the text can be inferred.
evidence_quotes: DESIGNATING ALABAMA HIGHWAY 10 BETWEEN THE PIKE COUNTY LINE AND THE CITY LIMITS OF CLIO THE DON SUTTON HIGHWAY.

WHEREAS, it is the great pleasure of the Alabama Legislature to recognize the accomplishments and contributions of Major League Baseball Hall of Fame Pitcher Don Sutton by naming a highway in his honor
BE IT RESOLVED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF ALABAMA... That the section of Alabama Highway 10 between the Pike County line and the city limits of Clio is hereby designated the Don Sutton Highway
